verdict.rationale: Docs confirm OCI maintains an official Terraform provider connecting Terraform to OCI services and even integrates with Resource Manager for state import, indicating vendor investment; however there's no evidence of release cadence, OpenTofu compatibility/registry listing, breadth of resource coverage, or independent corroboration of active maintenance. Missing for 10: release frequency/changelog evidence, explicit OpenTofu support statement, resource/service coverage breadth, and community/hands-on validation of the provider's reliability.
